main_body: A broadleaf tree: a large rounded green canopy on a thin brown trunk, standing on a dark green grass patch.
top_band: Organic canopy. The column at x=12 shows an outline at rows 1-2, then dark-to-mid green from row 3. There is no flat horizontal top band, only foliage clumps with a light highlight (L=135) at rows 17-18.
evidence: This is an organic tree, so it has no rigid top or front surface to check. The rounded canopy reads as a volume lit from above, with highlight clumps, and the trunk (rows 30-43) sits below it. The canopy shadow falls on the trunk top and the grass patch at the base is seen from above. No side face and no flat elevation are present. The organic kind matches, so it passes the 3/4 view.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 9 colours per tile, against 108-109 per tile and 427-567 colours for the references. The canopy has about 5 green steps and a tinted dark-green outline (0% neutral), with no flat 5x5 fills. But it is made of smooth, blobby clumps with no leaf-cluster texture, no individual leaf dots, and a trunk that is a plain flat brown stripe with no bark grain or roots. Beside the richly textured references it looks much thinner and flatter, closer to a sticker.
